nom: Philosophy Clear Days Ahead Oil-Free Salicylic Acid Acne Treatment Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including some describing it as 'oily oily' or ultra oily, report the cleanser controls mascne, strawberry nose and oil buildup without listed drawbacks.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several say it strips or flakes their skin and is too drying to continue using, while others with dry or drier skin report it clears breakouts without drying them out.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it keeps blemishes at bay and cleanses well without leaving skin dry or tight.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are divided: some report rashes, redness, itching and worsened breakouts after one use, while others describe it as gentle, non-irritating and usable daily without dryness.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s, 60s and 70s report the product keeps adult and late-onset breakouts, including cystic acne, at bay.

concerns.aging: Reviewers over 55, 70 and in their late 40s report the cleanser controls new pimples and cystic breakouts that appeared with age; no dissent noted for this group.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report dryness, tightness or flaking, some severe enough to stop use, while a comparable number specifically praise it for not drying their skin despite the salicylic acid.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with oily sensitive skin reports zero redness or excessive dryness; others report red, itchy rash-like patches spreading around the mouth and face after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports their skin barrier was disrupted after overuse combined with sunburn, requiring a barrier repair serum to recover.
concerns.spots: Reviewers frequently report individual spots, hormonal breakouts and blackheads reduced or kept at bay; one reports the spot-treatment version cleared blackheads specifically.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several buying for teenage children, report visible clearing of blemishes within days to weeks; a minority report no improvement or worsened breakouts, including one severe reaction in a daughter.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report reduced oil buildup and shine; no dissenting reports on oiliness specifically.

extraits.titre: Rash on acne on dry skin!
extraits.texte: I have bad acne and have used so many products to try and help. I have oily, sensitive skin. I used this for one wash with my regular face moisturizer after and the next morning I got all little white heads surrounding my mouth and chin and my cheeks and forehead had red itchy patches and dry patches. I have never experienced a product like this after just one use with one pump of soap. Maybe it's good for acne, but not for sensitive skin in any fashion. Extremely disappointing.

This might just be my own skin, but all Philosophy products tend to be too drying for my already dry skin, including this one. I wanted to like it but could not use it for long. It'd probably be great for someone with an oily complexion.

Definitely cant use this everyday. I got the worse sun burn which was my own fault but also my skin barrier was ruined for a good week. I used The Ordinary skin barrier serum and it brought my skin back to life. It felt really refreshing at first but I over did it and now im scared to use it again. My skin can be sensitive too so maybe not a good product for me. The spot treatment version did get rid of my blackheads.

extraits.titre: My Holy Grail of Acne Treatment
extraits.texte: This has been an absolute LIFESAVER. I have ultra oily sensitive skin, and this has kept me almost completely clear. It's gentle but effective, and I've had zero redness/excessive dryness. Plus it has a nice citrusy scent!

I have normal skin that's prone to dryness, but occasionally have hormonal breakouts that are tough to clear up quickly with most salicylic acid or benzoyl peroxide store products. However, like most philosophy skin care products, this salicylic acid cleanser (as well as their other 'clear days ahead' products) is highly effective yet gentle without drying your skin and instead leaving it soft. All of the products in this line are phenomenal at clearing skin & preventing breakouts without drying skin or causing any interaction or skin sensitivity with other skincare products such as retinol, AHA's or glycolic acid. I highly recommend any/all of the clear days ahead products as I've used them all and they far exceeded my expectations.

I developed cystic acne in my late 40's. This product is the only thing I have found that keeps it completely at bay. I use it every day and now I almost never break out. On the rare occasion I do, it will be a single eruption versus a covered chin and jawline.
I use this daily in the morning, combining it with Purity Made Simple at night. It's a great for my combination skin! I love the citrus scent!
